text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Amiodarone potentiates the response of warfarin-type anticoagulants (which are CYP2C9 and CYP3A substrates), leading to an increased INR by 100% after 3 to 4 days [amiodarone:drug_interactions:5]. This interaction can result in serious or fatal bleeding [amiodarone:drug_interactions:5]. To manage this risk, the dose of the anticoagulant should be reduced by one-third to one-half, and the INR must be monitored closely [amiodarone:drug_interactions:5].
